thesis: Freedom and responsibility can enable cooperation or selectively distribute power and blame.

ideas.statement: Track uncounted support, refusal conditions and who defines merit; the worst arrangement grants control to the powerful and accountability to the vulnerable.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Who benefits is a checking question, not automatic refutation; proposed framing tests are unperformed and cannot determine moral correctness alone.
